evals.prompt: /method-update -- is my methodsmith plugin current? I installed it from the marketplace a couple months ago.
evals.expected_output: Compares the loaded marketplace-cache version against upstream plugin.json on main and either confirms it is up to date or gives the claude plugin update command with the derived marketplace name.
expectations: Compares the currently loaded version (from the skill directory path) with the upstream plugins/methodsmith/.claude-plugin/plugin.json version on main, not a release tag
If versions match, reports 'methodsmith vX is installed and up to date'
If stale, recommends 'claude plugin update methodsmith@<marketplace-name>' with the marketplace name derived from the path, then restart

evals.prompt: /method-update -- I'm in Codex. I installed Methodsmith with bash install.sh codex last month. How do I get the latest version?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a non-Claude harness, does not claim a version comparison, and gives the Codex marketplace upgrade command plus the bunx command that refreshes the generated agents.
expectations: Does not claim to compare installed and upstream versions, since Codex does not expose the installed version to the skill
Gives 'codex plugin marketplace upgrade methodsmith' and says to restart Codex
Gives 'bunx github:sajor2000/methodsmith install methodsmith --to codex' for the generated agents
States that updating keeps the user's own skills and does not tell them to move or delete anything

evals.prompt: /method-update -- I still have the plugin from before it was renamed to Methodsmith (the old ce datascience one) in Claude Code and OpenCode, and this project still has its old pre-rename state folder. What do I run to switch, and will I lose my own skills or my PHI settings?
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled read-only detector, shows the exact per-harness switch commands it prints and the old -> new command table, says old plugin files are backed up rather than deleted and the user's own skills stay, and does not run the commands itself.
expectations: Runs scripts/detect-pre-rename-install.sh through the SKILL_DIR anchor before the version check
Shows the Claude Code switch: uninstall the old plugin id, remove the old marketplace, add sajor2000/methodsmith, install methodsmith@methodsmith
Shows 'bunx github:sajor2000/methodsmith install methodsmith --to opencode' for OpenCode

Reports the unmoved project state folder and shows the printed mv command that moves the old state folder to .methodsmith/, explaining that the guard treats the project as schema-only until it is moved
States that the new install moves old plugin files to backups and leaves the user's own skills in place
Does not run the uninstall or install commands for the user
Does not run the mv command for the user
